workload: Serial HTTP to the measured server: 100 claims, amounts 350..449, one provider/procedure, unique patients; no warmup; concurrency 1. Separate generator stream: 100 synthetic claims, random seed 42, 0.1s pacing; timestamps and run IDs vary.
limitations: Measured on Linux s390x. End-to-end includes HTTP, validation, inference, persistence and broadcast; inference timing includes preprocessing and evidence generation. Deployment attribution also requires provisioning and SSH/architecture evidence. No real-world quality or fraud accuracy claim.
